SELECT
  AVG(country_count) as avg_kept_country_count,
  AVG(CAST(country_count AS FLOAT) / total) as avg_kept_ratio,
  AVG(country_count - overall_avg) as avg_diff_from_avg
FROM (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    COUNT(*) as country_count,
    (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM races r2 JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId GROUP BY c2.country)) as total,
    (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM races r2 JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId GROUP BY c2.country)) as overall_avg
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
  HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM races r2 JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId GROUP BY c2.country))
)
